design.base: JRA official market probability + residual ensemble

basePredictionFinding.aucVsMarket: ensemble residual probability ranking improved on all five outer folds versus market in the latest run
basePredictionFinding.loglossVsMarket: improved on all five outer folds
basePredictionFinding.economicInterpretation: small probability-calibration improvement did not convert to a 200% betting edge

otherRobustChecks.fourTrainingFoldRuleRequirement: requiring every training fold ROI >=200% and trimmed ROI >=100% produced zero ensemble-ticket rules
otherRobustChecks.interpretation: the earlier 250-300% development pockets were not stable under stricter fully out-of-fold generalization

conclusion: No honest 200% model has been proven on the fixed archive under the current non-negotiable constraints. Do not assign v16 and do not change production from this diagnostic.
